purpose: Teach: 人的/地上波/成り立ち/林業/沼/沿線/練っ/質感

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、病院の人的体制、地方では脆弱です。
lines.en: Ren, hospital staffing in rural areas is quite fragile.
lines.style: Steady, clinical tone. Direct statement of fact without alarm. Measured pace. Brief pause after his name — professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地上波の医療ドラマ、誤情報、流れることもありますね。
lines.en: Medical dramas on TV do spread misinformation sometimes, don't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful, not accusatory. Small-voice observation — testing a thought aloud. Gentle question seeking confirmation, not contradiction.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。地域医療の成り立ち、歴史と地理が支えてきました。
lines.en: Yes. Regional healthcare has been sustained by history and geography.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Speaking from long experience. Unhurried, like explaining something true and complex. Slight emphasis on the weight of 'history'.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 林業従事者の健康問題、報告書、ありますか。
lines.en: Are there reports on health issues among forestry workers?
lines.style: Genuine inquiry. Slight lean forward in tone — he's asking because he wants to know, not to test. Respectful, not performative.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。沼地での蚊媒介感染症、注意しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're careful about mosquito-borne infections in marshland areas.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, grounded in practice. Concrete and specific. The tone of someone who has seen and prevented harm. No dramatising.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 沿線病院、地域連携、進んでますね。
lines.en: The hospitals along the railway line seem to be coordinating well.
lines.style: Noting something genuine he's observed. Warm recognition. Quiet approval in the voice — not gushing, just genuine.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。治療法を練った経験、若手に伝えます。
lines.en: Yes. We pass on what we've learned about treatment to the younger staff.
lines.style: Quiet continuity in the voice. Speaking of responsibility carried forward. Slight warmth when mentioning the younger generation. Steady, unhurried.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療現場の質感、ドキュメンタリーで伝わりますね。
lines.en: The texture of real medical work — documentaries really do capture that.
lines.style: Reflective trailing close. Soft, thoughtful tone. Like he's arrived at something true through talking. Slight fadeout at the end, almost to himself.
